about: Container images for bin/run-shard.mjs, pinned by the digest of the multi-platform index. node24: every helper (static reader, analyser, HTTP probe, egress proxy) and npm targets; node22: npm targets that ask for it; python: PyPI targets (venv + pip); go: `go install` only (the built binary runs in node24). Recorded 18 Nov 2026; change only by a reviewed commit.
